title: order-svc connection pool exhausted — deadlocks on orders + order_items tables
description: order-svc HikariCP pool saturated at 20/20 connections with 47 threads waiting. Deadlocks detected between concurrent transactions on orders and order_items tables. Caused by OrderService.findByStatus() not closing connections in error path (leak). Recommend: fix connection leak, tune maximumPoolSize to 50, add statement_timeout=10s.

title: Add connection pool monitoring and deadlock alerts for order-svc
description: No alerting on HikariCP pool exhaustion. Add alert for hikaricp_connections_active / hikaricp_connections_max > 0.9. Enable pg_stat_activity monitoring and auto-cancel long-running transactions (> 30s). Also enable Hibernate statistics to surface slow queries.
